_comment: Fail-closed deny list for the Development execution package. build_execution_package.py refuses to generate, and developmentExecutionManifest.test.ts fails, if any of these versions would be approvable or would execute. Local negative tests may still use them in isolated scratch databases.

blocked_no_safe_rule.rule: must stay in a BLOCKED, not-approvable batch class with no verification SQL; they enter an approvable package only after new read-only evidence and explicit owner approval, which would be a new Step 2 decision, not a regeneration

excluded_pending_owner.rule: update_pricing_rules: not an operation in any batch

never_sql_execute.rule: demo-admin creation: may be a signed attestation of history, never executed SQL

withheld_gate.rule: every manifest row whose disposition starts with 'Withheld' (October deployment gate and security-dependent migrations) is never an operation
